_what: PAIRED comparison of the two reader-prompt arms over the SAME responses. Two raw rates over two different sets would be unpaired; this is matched on (memory_id, future_task_id, replicate_id, arm).
_mechanism: 128 responses correct under the hand-written prompt became ABSTENTIONS under the official prompt. harness.py:1055 forces score_bool=False when is_unknown, so an abstention scores 0 exactly like a wrong answer: replacing a guess with an abstention cannot raise accuracy and can only lower it.
